commit.message:
LU-20411 ofd: fix lastid_rwsem leak in ofd_echo_create

The ofd_validate_seq() failure path returned without releasing
ofd_lastid_rwsem, which was taken a few lines above.

Found by CONFIG_WARN_CONTEXT_ANALYSIS.

Fixes: c336959222 ("LU-8667 osp: validate FID before initializing precreate seq")
Test-Parameters: trivial
